Package arztis.econnector.ihe.queries

Class XdsTransactions

java.lang.Object
arztis.econnector.ihe.queries.XdsTransactions
public class XdsTransactions extends Object
This class includes all needed transactions of IHE XDS (Cross-Enterprise Document sharing) and XCA (Cross-Community Access) integration profile. This profile describes the process of managing the sharing of documents between any health care providers.
This profile includes ITI-18 transaction to query registry for stored documents. Furthermore this profile contains ITI-43 transaction, which request document at repository. Another include transaction is called ITI-41 to provide and register documents. Moreover it includes ITI-8 or ITI-44 to identify patient.
This class contains ITI-18, ITI-43 and ITI-41 transactions. In ELGA reference client this three transactions are needed.

      public org.openehealth.ipf.commons.ihe.xds.core.responses.QueryResponse queryDocumentList(org.husky.communication.xd.storedquery.FindDocumentsQuery findDocumentQuery, String typeCode) throws Exception
      queries documents from registry with ITI-18 transaction. It queries metadata of documents for a given patient. This query could be limited through search criteria.
      Parameters:
      findDocumentQuery - details to restrict query
      typeCode - indicates which ELGA area should be used to query documents. There are different areas/endpoints to use for electronic records and virtual organizations. Values are available under https://termpub.gesundheit.gv.at:443/TermBrowser/gui/main/main.zul?loadType=ValueSet&loadName=HL7-at_XDS-Dokumentenklassen
      Returns:
      a list of QueryResponse, if the query find some matching data, otherwise it will also return QueryResponse
      Throws:
      Exception

    • provideAndRegisterDocuments

      public org.openehealth.ipf.commons.ihe.xds.core.responses.Response provideAndRegisterDocuments(org.openehealth.ipf.commons.ihe.xds.core.metadata.AvailabilityStatus status, String typeCode, org.husky.common.model.Code healthCareFacilityCode, org.husky.common.model.Code practiceSettingCode, org.husky.common.model.Code formatCode, org.husky.common.model.Identificator patientId, String parentDoc, org.husky.common.hl7cdar2.POCDMT000040ClinicalDocument cda, byte[] bytesDoc, String oid, String ownOid, boolean validate) throws Exception
      transmits a set of documents and associated metadata with ITI-41 transaction. The documents and metadata can be stored in different locations. The metadata provided allows the recipient to process the content of the message without having to understand the content of the document. There are different types of metadata. Some must be set explicitly and others can be read from CDA document. All metadata that must be explicitly set are passed as parameters. While all other required metadata is read from transferred document.
      Further information about XDS metadata can be retrieved from https://www.elga.gv.at/fileadmin/user_upload/Dokumente_PDF_MP4/CDA/Implementierungsleitfaeden/Implementierungsleitfaeden_2.06/Implementierungsleitfaden_XDS_Metadaten_V2.06.pdf
      Parameters:
      status - availability status of document to be provided
      typeCode - type code of document to be provided. Values are available in the subclass under https://termpub.gesundheit.gv.at:443/TermBrowser/gui/main/main.zul?loadType=ValueSet&loadName=HL7-at_XDS-Dokumentenklassen
      healthCareFacilityCode - classification of health care provider. Values are available under https://termpub.gesundheit.gv.at:443/TermBrowser/gui/main/main.zul?loadType=ValueSet&loadName=ELGA_HealthcareFacilityTypeCode
      practiceSettingCode - subject classification of document. Values are available under https://termpub.gesundheit.gv.at:443/TermBrowser/gui/main/main.zul?loadType=ValueSet&loadName=ELGA_PracticeSetting_VS
      formatCode - format of document content. Values are available under <a href=https://termpub.gesundheit.gv.at:443/TermBrowser/gui/main/main.zul?loadType=ValueSet&loadName=ELGA_FormatCode_VS>https://termpub.gesundheit.gv.at:443/TermBrowser/gui/main/main.zul?loadType=ValueSet&loadName=ELGA_FormatCode_VS
      patientId - ID of patient about whom document is written
      parentDoc - ID of parent document
      cda - POCDMT000040ClinicalDocument extracted CDA document, which is used to get needed metadata
      bytesDoc - bytes of XML document to be provided
      oid - OID of ELGA area in which document should be stored.
      ownOid - OID of document author
      validate - indicates whether CDA document should be validated before sending
      Returns:
      Response with details about success or failure of request
      Throws:
      Exception - the exception

    • getDestinationPatientIdHl7Cdar2

      public org.husky.common.model.Identificator getDestinationPatientIdHl7Cdar2(org.husky.common.model.Identificator patientId, String elgaAreaOid, boolean emed)
      extracts patient ID for ELGA area in which document should be stored. Destination patient ID for electronic records (eBefunde) must be the ID defined of ELGA area to store. For electronic medication, electronic immuization and virtual organizations social security number or bPk can be used as destination patient ID.
      Parameters:
      patientId - ID of patient about whom document is written
      elgaAreaOid - OID of ELGA area in which document should be stored.
      emed - indicates whether document is for eMedication
      Returns:
      patient ID which can be used to store document in ELGA area

    • cancelDocument

      public RegistryResponseType cancelDocument(String uniqueId, org.husky.common.model.Identificator patientId, org.husky.common.at.enums.ClassCode classCode, String organizationId, String authorInstitution, String oidElgaArea) throws org.apache.xmlbeans.XmlException, RemoteException, AccessDeniedMessage
      updates metadata attributes of document in registry with ITI-57 transaction. In ELGA it is only allowed to update metadata attribute for availability status. Therefore this method is implemented that availability status of document will be set from approved to deprecated. In other words, the document is cancelled.
      Parameters:
      uniqueId - unique ID of document to be edited
      patientId - ID of patient about whom document is written
      classCode - class code of document to be edited. Values are available under https://termpub.gesundheit.gv.at:443/TermBrowser/gui/main/main.zul?loadType=ValueSet&loadName=HL7-at_XDS-Dokumentenklassen
      organizationId - OID of organization that wants to edit document metadata
      authorInstitution - OID of document author who created document to be edited
      oidElgaArea - OID of ELGA area in which document should be edited.
      Returns:
      RegistryResponseType with details about success or failure of request
      Throws:
      org.apache.xmlbeans.XmlException - the xml exception
      RemoteException - the remote exception
      AccessDeniedMessage - the access denied message
